description_sq: Apartament 2+1 ofrohet per shitje ne Astir. Ndertim cilesor dhe i mireadministruar. Hyrje me hapesire te bollshme dhe kubature e rregullt. Totalisht e arreduar ne gjendje shume te mire. Orientim mjaft i mire cka i mundeson drite natyrale dhe diell. 2 Dhoma gjumi. Ambient ndenjie+kuzhine gatimi. 2 Tualete. Ballkon. Zone mjaft e preferuar dhe lehtesisht e aksesueshme. Mundesi shitje me kredi. Disponon certifikate pronesie. Cmimi eshte 16.000.000 Leke.
description_en: 2+1 apartment is offered for sale in Astir. Quality construction and well managed. Entrance with ample space and regular cubature. Fully furnished in very good condition. Very good orientation, which allows natural light and sun. 2 bedrooms. Living room + kitchen. 2 Toilets. Balcony. Very popular and easily accessible area. Possibility of sale on credit. It has ownership certificates. The price is 16,000,000 Lek.
